ic_name: DALI (Digital Addressable Lighting Interface, IEC 62386 via TI SLAA422A)

fsm_states_control_gear.name: POWER_UP
fsm_states_control_gear.description: Hardware reset. TI_DALI_Init() configures the GPIO (DALI_RX, DALI_TX, PWM1, PWM2, TPS62260_ENABLE), reads persistent variables from information memory into RAM, initializes Timer_A3 PWM (TASSEL_2 + ID_0 + MC_0 + TACLR; TACCR0 = 5000 → 1.6 kHz at 8 MHz SMCLK), TACCTL1 / TACCTL2 = CM_0 + CCIS_2 + OUTMOD_3 (set on TACCRx, reset on TACCR0), enables maskable interrupts. Actual Level := Power On Level. Within 600 ms, the device will automatically go to the Power On Level if no command is received.

fsm_states_control_gear.name: IDLE_WAIT_FOR_FORWARD
fsm_states_control_gear.description: DALI bus idle (HIGH). TI_DALI_Transaction_Loop() polls the DALI_RX edge-interrupt state. CPU may execute background tasks (e.g. TI_DALI_Idle_Callback exposed for application use).

fsm_states_control_gear.name: DECODE_FORWARD_START
fsm_states_control_gear.description: DALI_RX edge interrupt fires (start of frame: LOW→HIGH at mid-bit indicates start bit '1'). The CPU starts a Manchester bit-clock based on MCLK; each subsequent half-TE the CPU samples DALI_RX to reconstruct the bit cell.

fsm_states_control_gear.name: DECODE_FORWARD_BITS
fsm_states_control_gear.description: Shift-register reception of 16 bits: address byte then data byte (MSB first). Each bit is captured by re-arming the edge interrupt at the expected mid-bit boundary. If a manifest Manchester violation occurs (line not at the expected level at sample), the frame is silently discarded and the gear returns to IDLE_WAIT_FOR_FORWARD.

fsm_states_control_gear.name: DECODE_FORWARD_STOP
fsm_states_control_gear.description: Verify 2 stop bits (line continuously HIGH for ≥ 2 × bit-time). Failure → silent discard.

fsm_states_control_gear.name: VALIDATE_ADDRESS
fsm_states_control_gear.description: Decode YAAAAAAB. Match against this gear's Short Address (Y=0), Group membership (Y=1, AAAAAA != 111111), Broadcast (Y=1, AAAAAA = 111111), or Special-command pattern (1010/1011/1100). On match → proceed to EXECUTE; on mismatch → return to IDLE_WAIT_FOR_FORWARD (no backward frame).

fsm_states_control_gear.name: EXECUTE_COMMAND
fsm_states_control_gear.description: If B=0 → set Target Level = Data byte (0..254, or 255=MASK ignore). If B=1 → dispatch on command code: arc-power-level commands (0x00..0x09), GO TO SCENE (0x10..0x1F), RESET / STORE configuration (0x20..0x80), QUERY (0x90..0x99), special commands (0xA0..0xCF) including TERMINATE/DTR/INITIALIZE/RANDOMIZE/COMPARE/WITHDRAW/SEARCH/PROGRAM/VERIFY/QUERY SHORT ADDRESS/ENABLE DEVICE TYPE/DTR1/DTR2.

fsm_states_control_gear.name: FADE_RUNNING
fsm_states_control_gear.description: If the command launched a fade, Timer_A3 ISR steps Actual Level toward Target Level at the configured Fade Rate (TI_DALI_Update_Callback fires to enable CCIE in TACCTL1; ISR is disabled again after each step).

fsm_states_control_gear.name: PREPARE_BACKWARD
fsm_states_control_gear.description: If the executed command was a query and the address matched, build the 1-byte backward-frame payload. Wait the required 7×TE settle (TI uses ≈ 7 × 416.67 μs ≈ 2.92 ms after end-of-forward).

fsm_states_control_gear.name: SEND_BACKWARD
fsm_states_control_gear.description: Drive DALI_TX through the opto-isolator to Manchester-encode 1 start bit + 8-bit data byte + 2 stop bits at 1200 baud.

fsm_states_control_gear.name: WAIT_INTERFRAME_SETTLE
fsm_states_control_gear.description: After transmitting (or after decoding a non-query forward), enforce ≥ 22×TE (9.17 ms) inter-forward settle before the next forward-frame edge interrupt is re-armed. The IEC-recommended 13.5 ms is used as the practical floor in the TI implementation.

fsm_states_control_gear.name: CONFIG_MODE
fsm_states_control_gear.description: Entered on INITIALIZE (0xA5). Subset {RANDOMIZE/COMPARE/WITHDRAW/SEARCH H/M/L/PROGRAM/VERIFY/QUERY SHORT ADDRESS/PHYSICAL SELECTION/TERMINATE} are dispatched here. Auto-exit after 15 minutes (via WDT+ tick) or on TERMINATE.

fsm_states_control_gear.name: FLASH_UPDATE
fsm_states_control_gear.description: TI_DALI_Flash_Update() runs once before power-down (sensed by Comparator_A+ or external trigger). 32 bytes of information memory are written, two segments × 4.5 ms erase + 32 × 30 cycles @ 333 kHz program ≈ 2.88 ms. Hardware must hold VCC ≥ 2.2 V for ≥ 3 ms.

fsm_states_control_gear.name: SYSTEM_FAILURE
fsm_states_control_gear.description: Bus voltage low (< 9.5 V) for longer than the protected interval → Actual Level := System Failure Level; control gear may go offline until bus recovers.

fsm_states_control_device.name: BUILD_FORWARD
fsm_states_control_device.description: Compose 16-bit forward frame: address byte (YAAAAAAB) + data byte (direct level or command code).

fsm_states_control_device.name: TRANSMIT_FORWARD
fsm_states_control_device.description: Manchester-drive the bus at 1200 baud. Listen-while-talk monitors for bus contention.

fsm_states_control_device.name: WAIT_BACKWARD
fsm_states_control_device.description: After end-of-forward, start a 22×TE timer. If query, sample DALI_RX for start bit between 7×TE and 22×TE.

fsm_states_control_device.name: RECEIVE_BACKWARD
fsm_states_control_device.description: Manchester-decode 1 start + 8 data + 2 stop. Validate framing; deliver to application.

fsm_states_control_device.name: NO_RESPONSE
fsm_states_control_device.description: Timer expires with no start bit → report timeout to application (no NACK in DALI).

fsm_states_control_device.name: INTERFRAME_SETTLE
fsm_states_control_device.description: Hold off ≥ 22×TE (9.17 ms) — IEC-recommended ≥ 13.5 ms — before transmitting the next forward frame.

fsm_hints.validation_order: Frame integrity (Manchester + stop bits) → address match → command-code dispatch → fade/PWM update or backward-frame compose.
fsm_hints.broadcast_handling: Address Y=1 + AAAAAA=111111 → every control gear executes the command. Queries shall NOT be broadcast (collision risk).
fsm_hints.abort_conditions: Manchester violation, missing stop bits, or forward frame inside the 22×TE settling window → silent discard. DALI has no NACK frame.
fsm_hints.config_mode_timeout: 15 minutes after INITIALIZE if no further forward frame; gear leaves Configuration Mode and resumes normal operation.
fsm_hints.two_strike_rule: Destructive commands (RESET 0x20, STORE DTR AS SHORT ADDRESS 0x80, STORE DTR AS SCENE n 0x40..0x4F, STORE DTR AS MAX/MIN/SYSTEM_FAILURE/POWER_ON_LEVEL/FADE TIME/FADE RATE 0x2A..0x2F) shall be sent twice within 100 ms to commit; single delivery is ignored.

anti_deadlock_rule: Strictly request/optional-reply, master-driven; only the control device initiates forward frames. Backward frames are sent only by the addressed gear in response to a query, in a deterministic 7..22 TE window, and one query forward frame can produce at most one backward frame. Broadcast queries that could elicit overlapping responses (e.g. broadcast COMPARE) are part of the addressing iteration; the protocol resolves them via the wired-AND bus + RANDOMIZE / SEARCH ADDRESS bisection.
exit_from_reset_or_power_up: After hardware reset, the TI implementation: (1) calls TI_DALI_Init() which loads RAM variables from flash, (2) configures Timer_A3 (TASSEL_2+ID_0+MC_0+TACLR, TACCR0=5000, TACCTL1/2=CM_0+CCIS_2+OUTMOD_3, then TACTL |= MC_1 for up-mode), (3) enables maskable interrupts, (4) sets Actual Level := Power On Level. Within 600 ms after power-up, if no DALI command arrives the gear automatically applies the Power On Level. TI_DALI_Transaction_Loop() then runs forever in the main while(1).

default_state_recommendation.bus_idle_state: DALI bus HIGH (passive pull-up); MSP430 DALI_RX idle HIGH (after opto-isolator inversion).
default_state_recommendation.actual_level_post_reset: Power On Level (loaded from information memory).

fade_logic.fastest_fade_time: 25 ms across 254 levels (needs ≈ 10 kHz tick; would require 10.16 MHz core to use WDT+)
fade_logic.implementation_note: Spec footnote in §3.2 notes 10.16 MHz WDT+ tick is impossible (minimum interval is 64 cycles → would need 650 MHz input); the WDT+ may be replaced by a Timer_A module for fastest rates.

exception_response_logic.trigger: DALI has no exception frame. Faults are exposed via status bits returned by QUERY STATUS (0x90) and the dedicated single-shot queries (QUERY LAMP FAILURE 0x92, QUERY LIMIT ERROR 0x94, etc.).
exception_response_logic.no_nack: There is no negative-acknowledge frame; rejected commands are silently dropped.
exception_response_logic.client_action: Control device shall poll status via QUERY STATUS / QUERY LAMP FAILURE / QUERY LIMIT ERROR to detect failures.

interrupt_priority_order: DALI_RX edge interrupt (Port-2 IES/IFG bit) — used by the CPU to time-stamp Manchester bit edges; highest priority for accurate bit timing.
WDT+ interval interrupt — drives the fade-rate clock and special-command timing (≈ 1 ms tick).
Timer_A3 CCR1 interrupt — TI_DALI_Update_Callback enables CCIE in TACCTL1; ISR updates TACCR1 / TACCR2 from the LED[actual_level] table and disables itself again.
